assimilation_semantics.source_success: Broadcast only prior-layer workers with all Core tests passed and no infrastructure failure.
assimilation_semantics.no_success_behavior: Broadcast no experience; never fall back to partial or failed trajectories.

removed_from_agent_catalog: checkpoint specifications and tests after checkpoint 2
benchmark_isolation.prompt_prohibition: Agents may not inspect /problems, /outputs, evaluation tests, hidden tests, reference solutions, or paths outside the current workspace.

environment_fix.checkpoint_dependency_materialization: Merge public requirements from retained checkpoints; checkpoint 2 adds cssselect.
environment_fix.kimi_tool_call_compatibility: Translate native Bash tool calls with empty text content into the single bash code block expected by MiniSWE.

decision_rule.probe_gate: Proceed only if an isolated one-worker run reaches non-zero checkpoint-2 Core score without benchmark-catalog access or infrastructure failure.
decision_rule.performance_signal: Compare layer-wise normalized Core score and full-Core workers between strict source_success and no_transfer.
decision_rule.complexity_signal: Compare received experience characters and total input tokens across layers.
decision_rule.causal_caution: Require repeated runs before manuscript-level inference.

interpretation: Strict verified-success MoA contrast on the harder xjq checkpoint 2 task under benchmark-isolated execution.
